PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general fitness with safe moderate intensity, HR <70% max"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Base Conditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A (Intro)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B (Intro)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          calf_stretch 2m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Circuit Light (Low HR)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A (Progress)":
